about: The map: one record per stage of the journey. The page reads its text, labels, sources, framing and colours from here. re and im are the centre of the view; span is the height of the view in the complex plane; turn is the view's rotation in degrees at the bottom of the dive; iter is the iteration limit there. Where a stage has a period, its centre is the nucleus of a copy of the set with that period, and tests/stages.test.mjs checks it. Colours (palette, flow, density, glow) are artistic choices.

stages.title: The whole set
stages.label: exact
stages.place: z → z² + c, starting from z = 0
stages.note: Each point c either flings 0 off to infinity or holds it close forever. The points that hold are black. Every colour outside counts how quickly a point lets go.

stages.title: Seahorse Valley
stages.label: computed
stages.note: In the neck between the heart-shaped body and the round bulb to its left, filaments curl into seahorse tails. Each tail is made of smaller tails, as far down as we can look.

stages.title: Elephant Valley
stages.label: computed
stages.note: Near the heart's cleft the filaments march in rows of trunks. At the centre sits a small copy of the whole set: start at 0 and its centre comes back to 0 every 329 steps.

stages.title: Along a tendril
stages.label: computed
stages.note: Off the edge of the round bulb on the left, a tendril leads to another copy. This one repeats every 395 steps, and wears a crown of copies of its own filaments.

stages.title: The first copy
stages.label: exact
stages.note: Out on the spike to the left lies the largest copy on the line. Its centre solves c³ + 2c² + c + 1 = 0: start at 0, and three steps later you are back at 0.

stages.title: Down the antenna
stages.label: computed
stages.note: Further down the same spike, a copy that repeats every 113 steps. Snowflake arms radiate from it, and each arm is a chain of smaller copies.

stages.title: Double spirals
stages.label: computed
stages.note: High on the top of the body, filaments braid into lace around a copy that repeats every 228 steps. The colours are chosen; the shapes are only arithmetic.

stages.title: The set, again
stages.label: computed
stages.note: The deepest dive: almost four trillion times closer, in the mirror image of Seahorse Valley. At the bottom, the whole set again, small, whole, repeating every 116 steps.
